meaning: Machine-readable list of (repository, lane) cells with a recorded terminal outcome (R24 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, R20 NOT_APPLICABLE), read by the scheduled cohort selector (scripts/select_scheduled_cohort.py) so the autonomous loop never spends a hosted run on them. Each entry cites its decision in docs/DECISION_LOG.md. `revision` pins the upstream revision the decision was verified at: when the upstream default branch moves past it the terminal lapses automatically and the cell is eligible again (R24: it unblocks once the upstream fix lands and the repository is re-run). `recheck_by` is R24's 7-day re-check; the selector reports an overdue one. A new terminal decision is added here in the same commit as its decision-log entry.
